title: Malicious code in statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.review (npm)
description: The npm package 'statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.review' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to potential full system compromise, all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated from a different, secure device.
